verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Wrike's API has rate limits: it mentions a "rate-limit-friendly design" and a Batch API that reduces "rate-limit pressure." Nothing in the pack says what happens when a user exceeds automation or API call limits, whether extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop. Those mentions are adjacent mitigation features, not documentation of overage behavior, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
